title: Labyrinth Map Point Combinations
coordinate_note: Coordinates transcribed from user-provided image. x is latitude and y is longitude, following the original (lat, lon) tuples. For geometry, coordinates were projected to a local planar x/y system in meters centered on the mean GPS coordinate. Classification: convex if all selected points are vertices of their convex hull; otherwise concave configuration. This is point-set classification, not a specified walking-order polygon.
